The following lists of Biology Latest Dissertation Title Examples may help inspire you and plan your biological research. The titles are grouped by biological subfields for inspiration and motivation purposes:

Carnitine and Body Composition

“Novel Insights on L-Carnitine Ingredients with Fat Metabolism, Muscle Mass, and Recovery from Exercise: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis”

Why? Expands on the clinical trials in elite athletes with endurance vs. resistance performances and metabolic diseases (PCOS, obesity). 

Intervertebral Disc Regeneration

“Smart Biomaterials and 3D Printed Scaffolds for Intervertebral Disc Repair: A Meta-Analysis of Regeneration Potential and Mechanobiological Validation” 

Why? Includes hydrogels, stem cell-laden scaffolds, and AI-designed materials that are found in Ortho biologics. 

Amyloid Disease

“Novel Diagnostic and Therapeutic Strategies in Amyloidosis: Structural Biology and Spectroscopic Study of Fibrils”

Why? Taps into cryo-EM, NMR, and drug development aimed at fibril aggregation inhibition in Alzheimer’s and systemic amyloidosis. 

HIV/AIDS and Inequality in the UK

“Social Determinants and Health Inequalities in HIV/AIDS Post-COVID among Marginalised Communities in the UK”

Why? This literature review is focused on barriers to access and health policy, stigma, and the evolution of digital health in relation to marginalised populations. 

Antibiotic Resistance Crisis

“The End of The Antibiotic Era? A Critical Review of Global Trends in AMR and Novel Antimicrobial Strategies in the Era of Post-Antibiotic”

Why? Covers bacteriophage therapy, AMPs, resistance genes, One Health, and synthetic biology-based alternatives.

Gap Junctions

“Connexins and Gap Junctions in Cardiac and Neurological Disorders: Therapeutic Targets and Translational Perspectives”

 Why? Addresses their association with epilepsy, cardiomyopathies, cancer, and new compounds that modulates gap junction channels.

Multi-Resistant Organisms and the NHS

“The Economic and Clinical Impact of Multi-Drug-Resistant Organisms on the NHS: A Systematic Review of Surveillance and Intervention Outcomes”

 Why? Is aligned with NHS England’s ecosystem for StEW-ArDing antimicrobial stewardship, and hospital-specific infection control policies.

Artificial Substrata and Biofilms

“Nanotopography, and Material Coatings: How Engineered Surfaces Influence Biofilm Formation and Antibiotic Susceptibility”

 Why? Is relevant for catheter-associated infections, medical implants, and dressing materials.

Sleep Duration and Obesity

 “Investigating the Bi-Directional Relationship Between Sleep Duration, Disruption of Circadian Rhythms, and Obesity in the UK: A Cross-Sectional and Longitudinal Study”

 Why? Addresses issues associated with genetic polymorphisms, shift work, and hormonal regulation.

Resveratrol and Cancer

“Resveratrol as a Multi-Targeted Phytochemical for Cancer Chemoprevention and Therapy: Where to Begin and Focus on Signaling Pathways and Drug Synergy”

 Why? Addresses issues such as nanocarriers, use in combination with chemo agents and related to colorectal/breast cancer only.
